details.description: No top-level README.md explaining project purpose, usage, and structure.
details.why_required: Developers have no authoritative place to learn how to run or extend the project.
details.code_evidence: repository root contains package.json and src/ but no README.md

details.description: No instructions for installing prerequisites or running the project; `npm start` is broken.
details.why_required: Without setup/run instructions a developer cannot start or verify the project.
details.code_evidence: package.json: "start": "node src/index.js" (no file src/index.js). Actual CLI entry: src/input.js uses process.argv[2].

details.description: No examples showing how to invoke available tasks or expected outputs.
details.why_required: Developers need concrete examples to validate behavior and to extend tasks correctly.
details.code_evidence: src/input.js reads process.argv[2]; src/tasks.js exports build() and test() which print identifiable messages.

details.description: No documentation for the exported API (runTask) or task shape/contract.
details.why_required: Programmatic consumers and contributors need to know how to call and extend the API safely.
details.code_evidence: src/taskRunner.js exports runTask(name) and throws on unknown tasks.

details.description: No automated tests or instructions for manual verification are present.
details.why_required: Contributors cannot verify changes or CI behavior without test guidance.
details.code_evidence: package.json contains no test script; src/tasks.js has a test() task that only logs a message.

details.description: No Node engine/version, license, or repository metadata provided.
details.why_required: Useful for package consumers and for reproducible setups; not blocking but helpful.
details.code_evidence: package.json contains only name, version, scripts; no engines/license/repository fields.
